id.description: Channel collection id (CalDAV collection uri, chat-/dm- prefixed).

shareWith.description: Owner map of JMAP id (username or groups/{slug}) to rights. Null when not shared or caller is not the owner. Epic #1915: a grant to a user who no longer shares a Team with the owner, or to a Team the owner left, is left out here and the share is hidden for the sharee too (admins included). Nothing is deleted: the share comes back when they share a Team again. On the sharee's side the collection drops out of lists and lookups and /changes reports it destroyed, then created when it returns; native CalDAV/CardDAV clients drop their local copy and sync it again. An open app or offline cache on the owner's side keeps a hidden sharee until its next fetch of this collection, because the owner's own collection did not change.

isDefault.description: True for a group's auto-provisioned default channel: owned by the group principal, immutable through the generic channel endpoints (like DMs), name tracks the group display name.

topic.description: Channel topic shown in the main header subtitle (chat_channel_meta).

guestRoomCode.description: Meeting kind: linked meet_reservations room code for guest links.

dmPeer.description: dm kind: the other member's username (DM rail key); null for channel/meeting kinds.

memberCount.description: Roster size (owner plus sharees, groups expanded).

members.description: Usernames on the roster (owner plus sharees, groups expanded), lowercase and sorted. Clients send presence-mesh message previews only to these users.

unreadCount.description: Unread messages after the caller's read marker, own messages excluded.

kind.description: dm channels are never created here — POST /chat/dms provisions them find-or-create.

id.description: Optional client-suggested channel id: chat- followed by a ULID or UUID (any other shape is a 400). Kept when free. An id of a channel the caller can see is a 409; any other taken id is replaced by a server-minted one: the response id is authoritative. Without it, the id is the slug of the initial name plus a short random suffix.

guestRoomCode.description: Meeting kind only: persist the reserved ad-hoc room code shown at create time. Never rewritten to the collection slug.

principal.description: Target username — an internal workspace user other than the caller (no groups, guests, or external addresses).

groupSlug.description: Transfer ownership to principals/groups/{slug} (or back to personal with null). Moving a group collection out of its group (to personal or to another group) needs the same right as deleting it: only an instance admin; anyone else gets 403 `group_delete_admin_only`.

shareWith.description: Patch share grants. Keys are JMAP ids; a null grant revokes that principal. A user who shares no Team with the caller, or a Team the caller is not in, is refused exactly like an unknown principal (400 invalidProperties), admins included. A patch leaves hidden grants (sharees who no longer share a Team with the owner) untouched; shareWith: null revokes every grant, hidden ones included.

oldState.description: Previous sync state token supplied by the client.

newState.description: Current sync state token to store for the next request.

ChatChannelChangesResponse.description: JMAP-shaped incremental sync response for channel collections.
